investigations.name: tnf-fate-in-space
investigations.title: TNF fate in space
investigations.description: What decides whether a cell survives or dies when TNF reaches it by diffusion, and does space act only through the dose that arrives, or also through when it arrives?
investigations.question: What decides whether a cell survives or dies when TNF reaches it by diffusion, and does space act only through the dose that arrives, or also through when it arrives?
investigations.hypothesis: Pair each distance-study configuration (ring, bolus size, death clock, NF-kB arm) with a uniform bath that fades exponentially and gives its cell the same peak TNF and the same sensed dose, the receptor occupancy-time over 24 h (decisions 50 and 56). Where the fraction alive at 24 h is equivalent within 0.05, space acts only through dose (a configuration near everyone alive or everyone dead is flagged, since equivalence there says little about timing; decision 58); where it differs, the arrival delay or the pulse's shape matters; each configuration is equivalent, different or inconclusive (decisions 40, 40b, 53, 55). NF-kB's nuclear wave timing under the moving front is the mechanism either way. Every coupling is first calibrated (Study 0) on parts verified by the workspace's compose-api checks.
